name: Arrena Natural Mineral Water
verdict: Arrena is a Greek mineral-water company of the Tsakos shipping family. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: on Olympiacos BC's 2026-27 jersey as a small chest logo (Gazzetta, 9 July 2025; club store photos). Owned by the Tsakos family's interests - a Greek shipping family (Panagiotis and Nikolaos Tsakos), no state or fund in the chain, and no sourced human-rights finding against the company or family found (checked 2026-10-01).
